Dále absolvuje ZKOUŠKU PAMĚTI PRO VÝŠKU TÓNU A RYTMICKÝ DIKTÁT.'
gate.isProductionTestNotAudition: THIS IS AN AUDITION AND AN EAR-TRAINING EXAM, NOT A PRODUCTION TEST — and it is the single most important finding on FAMU. Round two requires a live performance (instrument, voice, or another live form) AND a pitch-memory test AND a rhythmic dictation. This is exactly the pattern the Filmuni Babelsberg finding predicted. He cannot pass it. Scoring is unforgiving: 'celkovou minimální hranicí … je 40 bodů ze 60 možných' and 'musí uchazeč/ka získat v každém kole alespoň minimální počet bodů z KAŽDÉ dílčí zkoušky' — a floor on every sub-test, so the ear test cannot be offset by a strong portfolio.

portfolioSpec: Fully specified, and the most precise spec in this slice. Three mandatory items for round one: (1) 'Soupis všech vlastních zvukových prací, vytvořených během bakalářského studia (audiovizuální či multimediální díla, hudební nahrávky, rozhlasová a divadelní zvuková tvorba)' — a list with title, genre, director's name, production, running time, year, ordered by date, including unfinished works. (2) 'dvě audiovizuální díla, na jejichž zvukové složce se významným způsobem podílel/a, podrobné explikace k oběma těmto dílům a vlastní teoretickou práci z oboru' — TWO audiovisual works where the applicant did substantial sound work, with detailed written explications, plus an original theoretical paper. (3) 'Projekt pro magisterské studium na FAMU' — a written statement of intended specialisation. FORMATS, verbatim: 'Zvukové soubory musí být ve formátu WAV kompatibilní pro běžné přehrání, případné videosoubory nejlépe ve formátu MP4/MOV v kompresi H.264, datový tok max 10Mbit/s', written documents in PDF, filenames 'ČÍSLO ÚKOLU - NÁZEV ÚKOLU - PŘÍJMENÍ JMÉNO' without diacritics. Non-FAMU graduates additionally submit CV, proof of the state bachelor's exam, and a school-certified transcript. A signed declaration of sole authorship is mandatory: 'Nerespektováním této zásady uchazeč nesplnil podmínku pro přijetí do studia.' Note: the required works are AUDIOVISUAL, not records.
costForTunisian: FREE. Czech-taught study at Czech public universities carries no tuition for any nationality, and this programme is 'česky'. The only costs are the application fee (poplatek za přihlášku, paid before the upload storage opens), living costs in Prague, and the visa. This is the cheapest genuine second-cycle degree in the entire slice — which is exactly why the audition gate matters so much.

There is a two-exam concurs: a written test on film culture and technical knowledge, then an oral colloquium in which the candidate defends one portfolio work AND OPENS ITS DAW PROJECT. That DAW-session defence is a production-craft test rather than an audition and deserves to be recorded as such. Also adds: language is Romanian, entry accepts a 180-credit bachelor with no subject restriction, and the intake is 3 budget + 3 fee-paying places.

gate.type: TWO-PART ENTRANCE EXAM INCLUDING A PRACTICAL PRODUCTION TEST
gate.quote: Part one: 'Тест из стручно уметничке области Музичка продукција', 'Писана анализа - евалуација музичког дела на основу субјективних и објективних критеријума које предлаже испитна комисија', and 'Разговор са комисијом' — pass/fail. Part two, scored: 'Оцењивање предатих радова ... до 30 бодова', 'ПРАКТИЧАН РАД НА МАТЕРИЈАЛУ АКАДЕМИЈЕ ... до 20 бодова', 'Провера знања из стручне уметничке области аудиовизуелних медија (разговор са комисијом) ... до 30 бодова'. Pass mark: 'Кандидат који на пријемном испиту не оствари укупно више од 50 бодова није положио'.
gate.isProductionTestNotAudition: THIS IS A PRODUCTION TEST, NOT AN AUDITION — say it plainly. 'Практичан рад на материјалу Академије' means practical work on the Academy's own material: they hand you raw material and you produce with it, over 'вишедневним вежбама' (several days of exercises). That is the job, not a barrier. There is NO instrumental audition, NO singing, NO solfeggio and NO interval identification anywhere in this exam — which makes Novi Sad structurally different from Detmold, FAMU and the Tonmeister family. One thing that LOOKS like an ear test is not one: 'ЛЕКАРСКО УВЕРЕЊЕ СА АУДИОГРАМОМ (офтамолог, оториноларинголог, психолог)' is a MEDICAL certificate with an audiogram from an ENT, i.e. proof his hearing is physically healthy — a clinic appointment, not a musicianship exam.

portfolioSpec: 'Портфолио радова насталих у претходне 3 године од датума пријемног испита' — a portfolio of works created in the THREE YEARS before the exam date.
